reason: These advisories describe the separate Chroma HTTP server collection/configuration/tenant authorization endpoints. RunWise uses an embedded PersistentClient behind its own JSON-only RAG API, does not run the Chroma HTTP server, does not publish the RAG port, and does not accept user model repositories or trust_remote_code configuration.
limitations: This is a narrow deployment-specific reachability assessment, not a claim that Chroma has no vulnerabilities. New advisories, versions, public RAG ports or a Chroma server require renewed review. Raw audit results must be retained.
